ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AB=10$, point C is the midpoint of segment AB, and point D is the midpoint of segment CB. Find the length of AD.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since point C is the midpoint of the line segment AB, \\
it follows that $AC=BC=\frac{1}{2}AB$, \\
since $AB=10$, \\
it follows that $AC=BC=\frac{1}{2}\times 10=5$. \\
Since point D is the midpoint of the line segment BC, \\
it follows that $CD=\frac{1}{2}BC$, \\
therefore $CD=\frac{1}{2}\times 5=\frac{5}{2}$. \\
Thus, $AD=AC+CD=5+\frac{5}{2}=\boxed{\frac{15}{2}}$.
